title: On $f$-polyharmonic maps between Riemannian manifolds
summary: This paper is devoted to a general study of $f$-polyharmonic maps of order $k$ (or $f$-$k$-harmonic maps), defined as critical points of the weighted $k$-energy functional \[ E_{f,k}(φ)=\frac{1}{2}\int_Ωf |\overlineΔ^{k/2}φ|^2 dv_g. \] This framework provides a unifying perspective that extends previous theories including $f$-harmonic maps ($k=1$), biharmonic and $f$-biharmonic maps ($k=2$), and polyharmonic maps ($k\ge 3$ with constant $f$), with the classical harmonic maps recovered as the special case $k=1$ by setting $f\equiv \mathrm{const}$.
